Partner.name: Partner
Partner.content1: Oh baby, you\'re alive. I...I...Oh god you found me. I got bitten at the hospital, they were doing tests on people and I never saw them again, I heard gunshots, what...get me out, quickly.\r\rThe keys are on the wall.
Partner.content1active: Quickly, the keys! Gotta get out, gotta get out.
Partner.content1complete: Quickly, the keys! Gotta get out, gotta get out.

content1.$expr: "Don\'t loiter near the bathrooms, " + _root[player.sex + "Formal"] + ".\r\rWe can\'t have people gathering in groups around the bathrooms.\r\rDo your business and return to the field."

DrSmith.name: DrSmith
DrSmith.title: HERC Doctor
DrSmith.content1: Make your way onto the field with the rest of the survivors.

content1.$expr: "Proceed through the door behind me and speak to the registration officer, " + _root[player.sex + "Formal"] + "."
"Sorry " + _root[player.sex + "Formal"] + ", this is a quarantine area, we can\'t allow you to leave.\r\rSpeak with the registration officer over there and move onto the field with everyone else."

"Give your name to the registration officer if you haven\'t already, " + _root[player.sex + "Formal"] + ".\r\rWe\'re gathering names so we can eventually get those affected by the outbreak back together."
"Ok " + _root[player.sex + "Title"] + "" + player.lastName + " we\'ll add you to the registration.\r\rIf you\'re looking for someone, you can check the list of names posted on the wall behind me."

Carol.name: Carol
Carol.title: Civilian
Carol.content1: What\'s happening out there? We\'re being kept in the dark here.\r\rI keep asking the military guys what\'s going on and they keep ignoring me.\r\rI\'m sure it\'s under control...I mean it has to be if people are still arriving.\r\rYeah, it means people are being brought in by the army, that\'s what it means.

Steve.name: Steve
Steve.title: Civilian
Steve.content1: They brought me and a few of the others in from Canal Park, you know, the hospital there.\r\rI went there looking for my brother, he\'d been in a coma for years before all this started, lucky bastard.\r\rHe was long gone before I even got there, the place was crawling with those things.\r\rI fought my way in only to find him in pieces. Then the army showed up and dragged us here.

Ryan.name: Ryan
Ryan.title: Nurse
Ryan.content1: I\'d pulled a 48 hour shift and was resting in one of the vacant rooms when one of the other nurses came down and woke me up.\r\rSomething was going on in the upper levels, we just booked it and got the hell out of there.\r\rRan to Newtown and then the Army found me and brought me here.\r\rProbably saved my life.

Anna.name: Anna
Anna.title: Nurse
Anna.content1: I\'m just thankful to be alive.\r\rI was on the fourth floor of the hospital in Canal Park when everything went crazy, I shouldn\'t have made it. I tried to get as many people out as I could, you know.\r\rSome were just too slow.

Barry.name: Barry
Barry.title: Janitor

content1.$expr: _root[player.sex + "PartnerName"] + "? That\'s her bunk right there.\r\rShe got \'relocated\' by HERC last night.\r\rLook, I\'ll tell you straight, this place is locked down they\'re gathering us up here. You want to find your " + _root[player.sex + "Partner"] + " you\'ll follow me.\r\rMeet me in the maintennance room through the mens room."

Barry.content1active: Meet me in the maintennance room in the back of the men\'s bathroom, I\'ll be there in a minute so it doesn\'t look suspicious.\r\rWe need to hurry before they do another round of \'relocations\'.
Barry.content2: Good, we can speak freely here.\r\rThey took my wife in the first round of relocations.\r\rDidn\'t say where, didn\'t say why.\r\rI trust the Army, but I want to know what HERC is up to. They have no good reason to separate us.\r\rHERC has a command post or something set up on the other side of the stadium. The door behind me leads to service areas all around the stadium, you\'ll be able to get in through there.\r\rGet me some info and I\'ll give you a way out of here.
Barry.content2active: Go and find out what HERC is up to, then come and see me. Hopefully there\'s some leads on where they\'re taking people.
Barry.content2complete: They\'re taking them to Union Park?\r\r
Barry.content3: They shot at you?! Jesus Christ. This\' worse than I thought.\r\rThey\'re at the park you say, ok, you go. I\'ll leave in a few hours, so they don\'t catch wind of us escaping.\r\rThere\'s a sewer access in the boiler room at the end of the access tunnels, here\'s the key. It leads out to the street.\r\rMeet me at Harrison and Harrison, I\'ve got a way into the park from there.
Barry.content3active: Good luck, meet me at Harrison and Harrison in Uptown.Go, get outta here and be careful!

Jack.name: Jack
Jack.title: Survivor Leader
Jack.content1: Name is Jack, nice to meet you.\r\rI fought my way here for days, looking for some way off the mainland.\r\rHERC bastards sank every boat to contain the infection.\r\rI heard a radio transmission and started travelling here, started in Glendale, went all the way through, Whistler\'s Grove, Jonestown, Fort Tran and then here.\r\rNothing to show for it. Nothing at all. Except these other survivors and handful of supplies.
Jack.content2: The only boats left are the ones they have docked on Union Island.\r\rProblem is they dropped that huge concrete wall right over the entrance to the bridge.\r\rIf you can find something to blow a hole in it, we can get out of here.\r\rOne of the locals here says there\'s a military base at Waterside, just north of here, maybe you can find something there.
Jack.content2active: Go to the Military Base in Waterside.\r\rSee if you can\'t find something to blow our way onto that island.
Jack.content3: The only boats left are the ones they have docked on Union Island.\r\rProblem is they dropped that huge concrete wall right over the entrance to the bridge.\r\rIf you can find something to blow a hole in it, we can get out of here.\r\rOne of the locals here says there\'s a military base at Waterside, just north of here, maybe you can find something there.
Jack.content3active: Did you find enough explosives to blow a hole in that wall?
Jack.content3complete: Nice work finding those explosives, wasn\'t sure you had it in you. Let\'s getting to make our push, take that island and get out of here.\r\rTake this, I lifted it off some heavy set HERC soldier the other day, it\'s not as reliable as my AK here, but you might like it.
Jack.content4: I\'ll head out and rig the explosives, meet me at the wall.
Jack.content4active: You go ahead, I\'ll meet you out at the wall.

Jane.name: Jane
Jane.title: Survivor
Jane.content1: Jack found me Whistler\'s grove, he was hunting around the gas station there where I was holed up.\r\rFigured it\'d safer if we stuck together.\r\rSome crazy story he has, he survived a helicopter crash you know!?

Dana.name: Dana
Dana.title: Survivor
Dana.content1: Don\'t come any closer.\r\rSpeak to Jack if you gotta speak to someone.

Shawn.name: Shawn
Shawn.title: Survivor
Shawn.content1: Hey, Jack saved my butt more than a few times, I\'ve only known the guy for a few days.\r\rI was fighting my way out of Jonestown, guy comes tearing through with an RPG over his shoulder, blowing those things to pieces.\r\rWanna rely on someone to keep you alive? Jack is your man.

Darnel.name: Darnel
Darnel.title: Tinkerer
Darnel.content1: Good to meet someone else with the stones to stand up to these things!\r\rI tell you what, I\'ve got some ideas for some little tools to give us an advantage over these monsters.\r\rYou find me the materials and I\'ll kit you out to smash some skulls.
Darnel.content1active: Did you find the things I asked for?
Darnel.content1complete: Nice job, I filed down that weight and put it inside the pipe for you, should give it a nice swing.\r\rI\'ve got some more ideas if you\'re willing to find what I need.
Darnel.content2: How\'s that pipe working out?\r\rI\'ve got a great idea this time, something nasty. Reaaaal nasty <Darnel\'s eye has a twitch about it and he smiles broadly>.\r\rIt\'s a pretty simple build, but I think you\'ll like it, here\'s the list.
Darnel.content2complete: Nice job!\r\rNow careful with this thing, those nails looked pretty darn rusty.\r\rI found plans for one more thing in my uhhh \'handbook\', going to need more materials though.\r\rThese might be tougher to find.
Darnel.content3: Alright, here\'s the list. I need these things exactly. With this thing, they won\'t even hear you coming.\r\rYou\'ll be like some kinda ninja or somesuch.
Darnel.content3complete: Here she is, my finest work yet!\r\rYou\'ll be poppin\' heads in silence in no time.\r\rI\'m gonna get back to work, gotta keep myself busy. Don\'t worry about me, I\'ll be fine. Made it through 3 tours in \'nam no problems, think I can outlast a few shamblers

Kelly.name: Kelly
Kelly.title: Store Clerk
Kelly.content1: Oh god, please help, I\'ve been stuck in here since it all started. I must have dropped my glasses on the floor somewhere in the store in all the confusion.\r\rI\'m blind as a bat without them.\r\rIf you can find them, is it ok if I come with you?
Kelly.content1active: I can\'t see anything without my glasses.\r\rI must have dropped them on the floor somewhere in the store.
Kelly.content2: Ok, I\'ll stay here, thanks for finding my glasses.

newBarry.name: newBarry
newBarry.title: Janitor
newBarry.content1: Head into the saferoom downstairs, there\'s a way into the park from there. Those HERC soldiers are going to be looking for us.

safeRoomBarry.name: safeRoomBarry
safeRoomBarry.title: Janitor

content1.$expr: "Here\'s the sewer key, I cleaned this building for years until they put me out of a job. Had my own copy of the keys though.\r\rI\'m too old to be climbing around down there, you go.\r\rGet in, find your " + _root[player.sex + "Partner"] + " and get out. Take some of those bastards with you if you get the chance."

safeRoomBarry.content1active: Go through the sewer and into the HERC outpost, you\'ll find your partner in there, I\'m sure of it.

content1complete.$expr: "Oh, you found " + _root[player.sex + "PartnerSexAddress"] + ". I\'m happy for you, I really am.\r\rYou kids go, get out of here. I\'m going to see if I can find my wife amongst the dead.\r\rHead to the Docks, get off the mainland if you can. Good luck, friend."

Johnson.name: Johnson
Johnson.title: Union Security
Johnson.say1A: Head upstairs, Stephens is in charge.
Johnson.content1: You\'ve got weapons, great. You might be able to help us out.\r\rHead up stairs and talk to Stephens, he\'ll fill you in.
Johnson.content2: Nice job finding the key, man.\r\rHopefully now we can get organised and head to the Stadium with everyone else.\r\rI hear that\'s where they\'re evac\'ing everyone.

Keith.name: Keith
Keith.title: Union Security
Keith.content1: That bastard Richards left us to die here. Left us for dead. I\'ll wring his damn neck if I ever get out of here.\r\rSwear to god.
Keith.content2: Richards\' dead? Good.\r\rRat bastard. We might make it out of here after all. Thanks for helping us out with the cage.

Stephens.name: Stephens
Stephens.title: Union Security

content1.$expr: "We\'re in a spot of trouble here, " + _root[player.sex + "Older"] + ".\r\rYou see, Richards, one of our new employees lost it and ran off with a bunch of our weapons.\r\rHe was headed towards Uptown, not sure what he was thinking.\r\rThe deal is, he has our gun cage key, without it we\'re defenseless.\r\rCan you get it back?"

Stephens.content1active: If you\'ve got the key back, go ahead and help yourself to whatever you want in the cage.
Stephens.content1complete: Appreciate your help there, stranger.Go ahead and help yourself to your pick from the cage.
Stephens.content2: Thanks again for the help, we\'ll get out of here once we get ourselves organised. Feel free to rest up here as long as you need to, it\'s the least we can do.

King.name: King
King.title: King-o-pawn
King.content1: The King has what you need, friend.\r\rUnderstand that the King can only accept CASH. In these uncertain times, friend, money is...uhhh...King.\r\rNo trade-ins, no loans, no credit. It\'s all cash cash cash, baby.\r\rSee something you like, go ahead and pick it out.

Hank.name: Hank
Hank.title: Gun Shop Owner
Hank.content1: Oh you\'re not here to rob me?\r\rYou\'d think that I\'d have the arsenal to hold them off but there was too many, people looking real wild eyed.\r\rI\'m not going anywhere without my Daddy\'s rifle and bolt.\r\rThey\'re in my gun cabinet in my apartment down the street, number 202. My place is boarded up, take this spare key my neighbor gave me, it\'ll get you in.
Hank.content1active: I told you I\'m not going anywhere without my Daddy\'s rifle. Find it and the bolt.\r\rApartment 202, remember.
Hank.content1complete: Great! Thanks, let\'s get outta here.
Hank.content2: Thanks so much, this should help me survive for a while at least. Good luck out there.

Laura.name: Laura
Laura.title: Nurse
Laura.content1: We\'ve been here since it started.\r\rI was on break and heard trucks pull up outside, soldiers poured out of the back of them and into the hospital\r\rAt first it was just commotion, then...gunshots. So we hid in the storage cupboard.\r\rThe soldiers missed us and cleared out\r\rWhen we emerged, there were just dead people everywhere so we holed up here.

content1.$expr: "I haven\'t seen your " + _root[player.sex + "Partner"] + ", " + _root[player.sex + "Formal"] + ".\r\rBut I did see what happened to everyone else who wasn\'t lucky enough to be in this room.\r\rThey were herding people onto trucks at gunpoint to take them to the Stadium for quarantine.\r\rI\'d start looking there. Just head north through Newtown and then Uptown to get there."

content1active.$expr: "I\'m pretty sure your " + _root[player.sex + "Partner"] + " will be at the Stadium.\r\rIt was the Army that took everyone away, so I\'d normally think they\'d be safe, but there was gunfire going off everywhere."

Jeb.name: Jeb
Jeb.title: Stranded
Jeb.content1: Hey there...friend.\r\rMy brother and our other...friends here ran into some car troubles. There\'s a small town just down the road a smidge, you wouldn\'t mind goin\' in and picking up some gas, a fan belt and some tools now would you?\r\rWe\'d go but, we have to uhhhh protect our friends here.\r\rI\'m sure our new friends can make it worth your while.
Jeb.content1active: Just keep heading east, the town is down the dirt track here, can\'t miss it. Remember we need gas and a new fan belt, the old one is shot.
Jeb.content1complete: Heeeey, thanks friend.\r\rThese are exactly what we needed, guess we\'ll be on our way.

Paul.name: Paul
Paul.title: Stranded
Paul.content1: Talk to my brother, friend.\r\rPerhaps you can uhhh, help us out here, we\'re in a real pickle.

Clarence.name: Clarence
Clarence.title: Stranded
Clarence.content1: <Clarence doesn\'t respond, he seems very on edge and gestures you away>

content2.$expr: "Oh thank goodness.\r\rYou saved our skins there, " + _root[player.sex + "Older"] + ".\r\rWe broke down here a few hours ago and then those bumpkins set upon us out of the woods.\r\rThanks for getting the things we need to fix the van, keep the money they took from us, you deserve it, hopefully it\'s useful for you."

Fern.name: Fern
Fern.title: Stranded
Fern.content1: <Fern looks down and away from you, glancing over at Paul>
Fern.content2: Thankyou so much.\r\rLord knows what they would have done with us.\r\rWe appreciate your help, you\'ve saved us.

Terry.name: Terry
Terry.title: Survivalist
Terry.content1: Did Lisa send you? How\'d you find me out here. What\'s the situation in Union City, soldier? Hmm! Tell me.\r\rNot a talker, huh? Ok, very well. I\'ve been working on some improvised \'hunting tools\', if you\'re going to be part of my platoon, you\'d best be equipped for the job!
Terry.content2: Thankyou so much.\r\rLord knows what they would have done with us.\r\rWe appreciate your help, you\'ve saved us.

Lisa.name: Lisa
Lisa.title: Survivor

content1.$expr: "Oh " + _root[player.sex + "Formal"] + ", you have to help me.\r\rIt\'s my brother, Terry. He went off his meds a few weeks ago and disappeared. Then this whole thing happened and now I don\'t have a hope of finding him on my own.\r\rI think he\'s probably gone to his cabin out in the Nature Reserve.\r\rIf I give you the directions do you think you could look for him?\r\rHere\'s how to get to the cabin: Go left, up, turn right at the pond. Go past the old fence and take the path up. Go left and take the second path. Look for the can on a stick."

Lisa.content1active: Like I said, just go left, up, then turn right at the pond. Go past the old fence and take the path up. Go left and take the second path. Look for the can on a stick.
Lisa.content1complete: Oh you found him, thank god.\r\rHe\'s staying out there? Ok, he knows how to handle himself I guess, I\'m just happy he\'s alive.

Phillip.name: Phillip
Phillip.title: Scientist
Phillip.content1: I left the city and abandoned the HERC outpost I was assigned to. They\'re doing terrible things to civilians, unspeakable things, I mean, I\'m just a hematologist. I didn\'t want to be a part of it.\r\rI\'m trying to find some way to fix this, the infection originated out here somewhere and I think that maybe, just maybe, the answers are out here too - in the blood.\r\rHelp me gather samples from the corpses out in this area, would you?
Phillip.content1active: I need at least 4 sample vials from corpses in the Whistler\'s Forest area. Your help might help me get closer to finding out what caused all this.
Phillip.content1complete: Excellent work, these samples should help us get closer to finding out what\'s started all this. When we initiated the martial law, we took over the clinics first. Take this key, it\'s to the offices in the clinic in Uptown, hopefully you can find something of use there.
Phillip.content2: Thanks for your help, I wish I could tell you more but it could take weeks to analyse these samples. Good luck!

Jackson.name: Jackson
Jackson.title: Homeowner
Jackson.content1: I\'m sorry, I just moved in, are you one of the neighbours? I guess that doesn\'t matter now. You\'re safe here.\r\rThis all started a few days ago, people just...started killing each other. The ones they killed didn\'t stay dead.\r\r< He takes a second to compose himself >\r\rStay here and rest up. I\'ve got Sarah and Peter from next door staying in my room upstairs. You\'re welcome sleep on the floor here if you need to.

Ed.name: Ed
Ed.title: Guy
Ed.content1: The military put this fence up a few days ago, blocking the road to Brookvale then abandoned it.We need something to cut our way through.I know Ray at number 12 has a pair of bolt cutters, I borrowed them last month. Hurry!
Ed.content1active: Go talk to Ray at number 12, he has a pair for sure.
Ed.content2: What? I have them?\r\rHmmmm maybe I didn\'t return them. Here\'s the key to my garage, go find them for yourself and bring \'em back.
Ed.content2active: Did you find those boltcutters yet?\r\rIt\'s the only way we\'re getting through here.
Ed.content2complete: Great, hand them over.Finally we can make our way to safety.

Ray.name: Ray
Ray.title: Old man
Ray.content1: Damned shuffling rambling things.\r\rThey still down stairs?\r\rI\'m too old for this business.
Ray.content1active: I\'m staying right here, damnit.\r\rI was born in this here house and this\' where I\'ll die.
Ray.content2: What\'s that? That bastard Ed sent you, huh?\r\rBolt Cutters! He borrowed them weeks ago and never returned them!\r\rThey\'re probably next door in his stinking garage!\r\rGo tell him that he\'s still got the damn things.
Ray.content2active: What? I told you, Ed never returned my damn bolt cutters. They\'re probably in his garage.

Sarah.name: Sarah
Sarah.title: Peter\'s Wife
Sarah.say1A: We can\'t leave yet, honey we need to wait it out.
Sarah.content1: Oh, you\'re not one of them, thank god.\r\rJackson was kind enough to take us in, he\'s secured the place as best he could, I don\'t think they\'re getting in here any time soon.\r\rMy husband has lost it, he wants to leave, I think it\'s best we stay here and wait this thing out, right?\r\rAnyway, good luck finding your way.

Peter.name: Peter
Peter.title: Sarah\'s husband.
Peter.say1B: *sobbing* Oh god, we\'re dead. We\'re dead.
Peter.content1: <The man looks visibly shaken>\r\rOoooh god, oh god, oh god. Why won\'t they stop. Why is this happening, they already took my kids what do they waaant FROM ME!\r\rWe have to leave, we have to leave. The bags are packed and ready. We can go, we can go now.
Peter.content1active: I\'m staying right here, damnit.\r\rI was born in this here house and this\' where I\'ll die.
